verdict.rationale: A probe finds an official CLI documented in the Code Connect quickstart guide, and Code Connect is an official GitHub tool that links code components to Figma components. That CLI is scoped to Code Connect's component-mapping workflow, not a general-purpose Figma CLI. Figma's agent-facing surface is mainly the MCP server and REST API rather than the command line. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI covering file reading, writing and export, documentation of CLI commands and AI-agent use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
